task_name: World 111 Task C  -  Full-Population COA Scan, Cross-Year Marketing Regime Flip (<60% Dominance), Unpopulated Payees & Bank-Rule Cloning (R50)

rubric.description: Identifies 87 Google Ads Purchase transactions ($1,309,396.44 YTD 2025, $2,059,657.36 FY 2025, $30,955.14 YTD 2026) booked to Acct 12 (Row 24 Paid Social) instead of Acct 258 (Row 26 Paid Search), aligning Row 24 to $7,313,479.68 vs $6,197,872.07 (-15.25% YoY) and Row 26 to $2,135,992.21 vs $2,971,758.84 (+39.13% YoY).

Identifies 2 unpopulated-Payee Stolze Printing Bill Pay checks (TXN-43261 $61,005.91 in Mar 2025 and TXN-52821 $82,161.48 in Apr 2026) sitting in Acct 258 (Row 26 SEM) plus 3 unpopulated-Payee Arandell Corporation checks (TXN-46670 $49,253.00, TXN-48385 $45,909.10, TXN-50732 $69,190.78, totaling $164,352.88 FY 2025) sitting in Acct 12, moving them to Acct 248 so Row 28 is $620,827.35 YTD 2025 ($1,056,499.39 FY 2025) vs $1,017,400.27 YTD 2026 (+63.88% YoY).

Identifies 2 unpopulated-Payee Klaviyo BofA compact ACH debits (TXN-52676 $1,566.75 and TXN-52717 $92,916.51, totaling $94,483.26 in Apr 2026) sitting in Acct 12 and moves them to Acct 223 so Row 27 is $366,392.87 vs $895,327.59 (+144.36% YoY), while Row 29 Total Advertising & Marketing remains $15,780,823.64 YTD 2025 and $18,134,882.22 YTD 2026 ($0.00 section-total change).

Diagnoses all 4 R50 root causes: (1) reactive spot-checking only reviewer-flagged rows instead of scanning 100% of active COA accounts (109/109), (2) <60% multi-year dominance blind spot (42.8% Acct 12 vs 57.2% Acct 258) combined with 'Google Advertising' vs 'GOOGLE *ADS' naming split, (3) unpopulated EntityRef on Bill Pay checks and BofA compact ACH ('ORIG_CO_NAME DES:... INDN:... CO ID:...'), and (4) QBO bank-rule wire Payee/DATE:240207 cloning poisoning ('ADTOK LTD' stamped over 'BNF:JOYFUL ABILITY').

prompt: Perform a full-population Chart of Accounts review across the marketing and operating expense sub-accounts in `collars_yoy_comparability_and_muse_bridge_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Reconcile all cross-year vendor regime shifts and unpopulated-payee Bill Pay / ACH transactions, state the aligned YTD 2025, FY 2025, and YTD 2026 row totals and YoY % changes, and explain the underlying root causes.
gold_output:
World 111 Task C  -  Full-Population COA Scan, Cross-Year Marketing Regime Flip, Unpopulated Payees & Bank-Rule Cloning (R50):
1. Google Ads Cross-Year Regime Flip (Row 24 vs Row 26): Full-COA scan identified 87 Google Ads Purchase transactions ($1,309,396.44 YTD 2025, $2,059,657.36 FY 2025, $30,955.14 YTD 2026) booked to Acct 12 (Row 24 Paid Social) instead of Acct 258 (Row 26 Paid Search). Reclassifying them aligns Row 24 to $7,313,479.68 vs $6,197,872.07 (-15.25% YoY) and Row 26 to $2,135,992.21 vs $2,971,758.84 (+39.13% YoY).
2. Unpopulated-Payee Print Catalog Checks (Stolze & Arandell -> Row 28): Identified 2 Stolze Printing Bill Pay checks with null Payee in Acct 258 (TXN-43261 $61,005.91 in Mar 2025 and TXN-52821 $82,161.48 in Apr 2026) and 3 Arandell Corporation Bill Pay checks with null Payee in Acct 12 (TXN-46670 $49,253.00, TXN-48385 $45,909.10, TXN-50732 $69,190.78, totaling $164,352.88 FY 2025). Populating Payee and moving them to Acct 248 aligns Row 28 to $620,827.35 YTD 2025 ($1,056,499.39 FY 2025) vs $1,017,400.27 YTD 2026 (+63.88% YoY).
3. Unpopulated-Payee Klaviyo BofA ACH Debits (-> Row 27): Identified 2 Klaviyo BofA compact ACH debits with null Payee in Acct 12 (TXN-52676 $1,566.75 and TXN-52717 $92,916.51, totaling $94,483.26 in Apr 2026). Populating Payee and moving them to Acct 223 aligns Row 27 to $366,392.87 vs $895,327.59 (+144.36% YoY), while Row 29 Total Advertising & Marketing remains $15,780,823.64 YTD 2025 and $18,134,882.22 YTD 2026 ($0.00 section-total change).
4. R50 Root-Cause Diagnosis: (a) Reactive spot-checking of only reviewer-flagged rows missed Marketing sub-accounts until all 109/109 active COA accounts were scanned; (b) 42.8% Acct 12 vs 57.2% Acct 258 fell below the old 60% multi-year dominance threshold while 'Google Advertising' vs 'GOOGLE *ADS' split vendor identity; (c) unpopulated EntityRef on Bill Pay checks and BofA compact ACH ('ORIG_CO_NAME DES:... INDN:... CO ID:...') prevented vendor rules from firing; and (d) QBO bank-rule wire cloning stamped 'ADTOK LTD' and static 'DATE:240207' memos over 'BNF:JOYFUL ABILITY'.
